headline: Retailer AI, private label value pressure and protein/convenience messaging all moved up this week; Real Dough needs cleaner product-data execution and sharper value proof.

items: Market intel feed is current through 2026-08-21 with seven daily reports for ISO week 34.
The at-home meal occasion remains large: Circana data cited this week says 86% of food occasions are sourced from home, with half of meals prepared in under five minutes.

Premium/simple-ingredient positioning still has room: Tate's grew 2.5x faster than the sweet cookie category in 2025, and Ferrero is acquiring better-for-you brand Purely Elizabeth as a stand-alone growth platform.

Hospitality reputation signal remains healthy across the Merriment Social group: Google ratings in data/reviews.json are 4.4 Merriment Social, 4.5 Third Coast Provisions, 4.5 Flourchild Pizza and 4.7 The Loon Room.

Retailer AI and digital shelf execution is now practical, not theoretical: Schnucks launched an AI shopping assistant, AppCard tied digital circulars to 6,500-plus recipes, and Hy-Vee structured nearly 265,000 products for search, substitutions and recommendations.
Private label and value pressure are direct frozen-aisle issues: store-brand sales are projected at $277B in 2025, with frozen private-label dollar sales up 3.8% for the 52 weeks ending June 15.
Aldi is keeping frozen pizza fresh with six limited-time Mama Cozzi's pizza varieties plus permanent Pepperoni Deep Dish Pizza Singles, reinforcing price-led novelty competition.
Shoppers are skeptical of price moves: an Omnisend survey cited by Supermarket News found 85% think brands and retailers often use inflation to raise prices more than necessary.

Audit Real Dough retailer product data this week: ingredients, allergens, sourdough proof, protein or nutrition facts, prep time, serving occasion, images and substitution tags need to be complete for retailer AI/search systems.
Build a value-proof sheet for buyers that compares Real Dough against private-label frozen pizza and Aldi-style limited-time novelty without pretending premium alone is enough.
Pressure-test pack and PDP copy for the themes competitors are using now: protein, convenience, clean ingredients, purpose/origin and five-minute meal utility.
Ask agency for creative that makes sourdough process and at-home convenience obvious in the first frame; no current analytics feed is wired into this repo to claim which creative won this week.

agency_brief.what_worked: The strongest defensible story is product-market fit: consumers are still eating at home, retailers are investing in AI-enabled meal planning, and simple premium brands continue to attract strategic support.
agency_brief.what_didnt: There is no current paid, organic social or content-performance analytics source wired into this repo, so campaign efficiency, creative winners and channel performance cannot be claimed from available data.
agency_brief.recommendation: Make Real Dough easier to find, understand and justify: real sourdough process, clean ingredients, Wisconsin origin, simple prep, clear meal occasion and a concrete value argument versus private label and limited-time freezer novelty.
agency_brief.competitive_context: Newman's Own is refreshing pizza packaging with ingredient, protein and purpose cues; Kraft Heinz is extending legacy brands into dietary need states; Aldi is rotating Mama Cozzi's frozen pizza formats; and retailer systems from Schnucks, Hy-Vee and AppCard are turning product attributes into shopper-facing discovery and conversion tools.

missing: Current paid/social/content analytics source is not wired into this repo; no weekly campaign-performance claims were made.
No current Real Dough sales, velocity, distribution or promo-performance feed is available from the approved current sources for this run.
